title: A Complete Guide to Marketing ROI Tracking | LivePlan

facts.fact: Slidebean had about $2,000-$3,000 of marketing budget to spend each month in 2015.
facts.quote: Back in 2015 when we only had about $2,000-$3,000 worth of marketing budget to spend each month

facts.fact: Google limits conversion goals to 20 per account in Google Analytics, according to the article.
facts.quote: Google limits conversion goals to 20 per account, so feel free to use them all up at the very beginning

facts.fact: Google Analytics goals do not allow looking at historical data, so goals only record conversions after they are set up.
facts.quote: the goals function doesn’t allow you to look at historical data, so they will only start recording conversions once you have set them up.

facts.fact: Google Analytics is described by the article as a free analytics tool.
facts.quote: Google Analytics is a very powerful (and free) tool.

facts.fact: Under the UTM Medium parameter, Google Analytics automatically classifies CPM/CPC visitors as paid traffic.
facts.quote: Google Analytics will automatically consider any CPM/CPC visitor as “paid traffic.”

facts.fact: Facebook pixels track page views by default (PageView), and Facebook offers default conversion events such as "Lead" or "CompleteRegistration".
facts.quote: Facebook has a default set of events like “Lead” or “CompleteRegistration” that you can trigger when a user clicks a particular button

facts.fact: The article's rule of thumb for SaaS companies is that customer lifetime value should be more than three times the customer acquisition cost (LTV > 3x CAC).
facts.quote: should be more than three times higher than the cost of acquisition (or CAC) of that customer.

facts.fact: For SaaS businesses, the article's formula calculates LTV as ARPU divided by the average monthly churn rate.
facts.quote: LTV = ARPU-Average Revenue per User/Average Monthly Churn Rate

facts.fact: The article's authors estimated the single-purchase LTV of their own product at 1.4 times the value of the original transaction.
facts.quote: which is now at 1.4x the value of the original transaction

facts.fact: The article advises that spend per campaign should ideally be 1/3 or less of the estimated LTV generated by that campaign.
facts.quote: Your spend per campaign should certainly be lower than this number, ideally 1/3 or less.

facts.fact: According to the article, Google Analytics assigns a sign-up's conversion credit to the last campaign that brought the user to the website.
facts.quote: because Google Analytics assigns the sign up to the last campaign that brought the user to the website.

facts.fact: According to the article, Kissmetrics receives campaign source data through UTM tags and records each user's first source campaign in their activity log.
facts.quote: this is transferred to Kissmetrics using UTM tags

facts.fact: The article's authors' customer source data consists of one to six columns sourced from Kissmetrics.
facts.quote: This consists of one to six columns that we source from Kissmetrics.

facts.fact: The article's authors copied a two-question checkout survey system from Squarespace to track marketing efforts.
